settings.headline: Software Developer | Data Analyst
settings.intro_text: I build practical software systems and turn data into insight.
settings.bio_markdown:
I studied ICT at Jaramogi Oginga Odinga University of Science and Technology (BSc. ICT, 2021 to 2025). My data analytics skills come from that coursework and from certifications in MySQL and Tableau, analytics for project management, and Data and AI. Most of my analysis work uses SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau.

Alongside the analysis I build software. A Laravel legal operations and case management platform for a county government setting is my main active build. Earlier work includes Campus Crib, a PHP and MySQL hostel discovery platform that was my final-year project. I also deploy what I build, with hands-on experience running applications on a Contabo Linux VPS with Nginx and HTTPS.

My first roles were in IT operations. I supported the Office of the County Attorney at the County Government of Kilifi, then worked as a Field System Administrator Officer on a hospital management information system rollout. I currently volunteer in ICT at Kilifi County Hospital, supporting the TaifaCare rollout. Outside of work I teach data skills on TikTok as Data with Denis.
